items.source:
Default implementation returns a simple description for the MBean
based on the class name.
items.translation: 默认实现根据类名返回 MBean 的简单描述。

items.source: managedBean - the bean that will be exposed (might be an AOP proxy)
items.translation: managedBean - 将被暴露的 Bean（可能是 AOP 代理）

items.source: the bean class to expose
items.translation: 要暴露的 Bean 类

items.source: This class offers two flavors of Class extraction from a managed bean instance: getTargetClass(Object), extracting the target class behind any kind of AOP proxy, and getClassToExpose(Object), returning the class or interface that will be searched for annotations and exposed to the JMX runtime.
items.translation: 该类提供两种从托管 Bean 实例提取类的模式：getTargetClass(Object)，用于提取任何类型的 AOP 代理背后的目标类，以及 getClassToExpose(Object)，返回将在其上搜索注解并暴露给 JMX 运行时的类或接口。

items.source: Default implementation returns an empty array of ModelMBeanConstructorInfo.
items.translation: 默认实现返回一个空的ModelMBeanConstructorInfo数组。

items.source: Default implementation is empty, accepting every bean instance.
items.translation: 默认实现为空，接受所有 Bean 实例。

items.source:
Default implementation returns the target class for an AOP proxy,
and the plain bean class else.
items.translation: 默认实现返回 AOP 代理的目标类，否则返回普通 Bean 类。

items.source:
Subclasses can implement this method to add additional descriptors to the
MBean metadata. Default implementation is empty.
items.translation: 子类可以重写此方法以向 MBean 元数据添加额外的描述符。默认实现为空。

items.source: Create an instance of the ModelMBeanInfoSupport class supplied with all JMX implementations and populates the metadata through calls to the subclass.
items.translation: 创建由所有 JMX 实现提供的 `ModelMBeanInfoSupport` 类的实例，并通过调用子类来填充元数据。

items.source:
Return the class or interface to expose for the given bean.
This is the class that will be searched for attributes and operations
(for example, checked for annotations).
items.translation: 返回给定 Bean 要暴露的类或接口。这是将搜索属性和操作（例如检查注解）的类。

items.source:
Return the class or interface to expose for the given bean class.
This is the class that will be searched for attributes and operations
items.translation: 返回给定 Bean 类要公开的类或接口。这是将搜索属性和操作的类。

items.source:
Get the attribute metadata for the MBean resource. Subclasses should implement
this method to return the appropriate metadata for all the attributes that should
be exposed in the management interface for the managed resource.
items.translation: 获取 MBean 资源的属性元数据。子类应实现此方法，以返回应在管理接口中暴露的所有属性的适当元数据。

items.source:
Get the operation metadata for the MBean resource. Subclasses should implement
this method to return the appropriate metadata for all operations that should
be exposed in the management interface for the managed resource.
items.translation: 获取 MBean 资源的操作元数据。子类应实现此方法，以返回应在管理接口中暴露的所有操作的适当元数据。
